value_note: Inline facts use plain business values plus sentinels (unknown/conflict/assumed/not_applicable). Confirmation state is attached when these are loaded into fact cards, not encoded in the value.

cases.description: A fictional Hong Kong group entity receives a foreign dividend; evidence is intentionally incomplete.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Requires expert review before any rule result is treated as valid.

cases.description: A fictional case contains conflicting receipt-location statements.
cases.notes: Tests that conflict is not silently converted into a negative answer; the conflict itself is the blocker.

cases.description: A fictional case has a candidate participation pathway but no evidence of the foreign tax condition.
cases.notes: Thresholds and application are deliberately not encoded as a final legal conclusion.

cases.description: A fictional entity carries on business in Hong Kong but is NOT an MNE entity; FSIE scope fails deterministically.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Exercises the scope not_satisfied branch; downstream nodes must not escalate while scope is unsettled.

cases.description: A fictional MNE entity earns foreign INTEREST, which is outside the L0 dividend slice.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Exercises the income-type out-of-slice branch.

cases.description: A fictional case where the dividend was received OUTSIDE Hong Kong.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Exercises the receipt not_satisfied branch and chain degradation.

cases.description: A fictional case with an established chain but a 4% holding, below the s.15M(2) percentage threshold.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Deterministic threshold failure must be condition_not_demonstrated, never a human escalation.

cases.description: A fictional case with a 20% holding kept for only 6 months, below the s.15M(2) period threshold.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Exercises the period dimension of the s.15M(2) threshold.

cases.description: A fictional case with conflicting statements about whether the entity belongs to an MNE group.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Conflicts on scope facts must escalate exactly like receipt conflicts.

cases.description: A fictional case with an established chain and partial economic-substance facts; sufficiency is a Commissioner judgement.
cases.notes: Not a tax gold label. Substance sufficiency under s.15K can never be mechanically proven; escalation is the only honest output.
